page_title: CHE 4-2 BHA | Chelsea v Brighton 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Peter Bankes is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) works the corner short.

90+4' That's unlucky! Pedro Neto (Chelsea) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Chelsea force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+4' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Yasin Ayari (Brighton).
90+1' Julio Enciso (Brighton) receives a defence-splitting pass from Yankuba Minteh and shoots early from the edge of the box, but his poor attempt goes well wide of the left post.
90+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Julio Enciso (Brighton) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Robert Sanchez to dive and make a save.

88' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Peter Bankes blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Brighton win a free kick.
83' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but Robert Sanchez comes off his line to gather the ball.
81' Here's the change. Danny Welbeck leaves the pitch and Evan Ferguson (Brighton) comes on as a substitute.
80' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Danny Welbeck (Brighton) as his effort only hit the wall.
79' Enzo Maresca decides to make a substitution. Nicolas Jackson will be replaced by Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea).
79' The game has come to an end for Enzo Fernandez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Romeo Lavia (Chelsea).
78' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) has tested the patience of referee Peter Bankes and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
76' Pedro Neto pulls the ball back to Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) inside the box, but despite having a clear sight of goal he blasts the ball just past the right post.
75' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) commits a rough foul. Peter Bankes stops the game and makes a call. Brighton are awarded a free kick.
73' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

72' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Chelsea will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' Here comes a substitution. Ferdi Kadioglu is given a rest as he is replaced by Julio Enciso (Brighton).
71' It will be a substitution. Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is ready to enter the pitch as Georginio Rutter walks off.
71' Enzo Maresca prepares a substitution. Jadon Sancho is replaced by Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea).
71' The goal by Chelsea won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
71' Wait! Referee Peter Bankes has indicated he is going to review the Chelsea goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marc Cucurella trots off the pitch and is replaced by Renato Veiga (Chelsea).
69' Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Pedro Neto knock down. 5:2.
68' Chelsea will take a corner kick.

68' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
68' The corner from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is cleared away by the defence.

67' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Chelsea.
65' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
65' Peter Bankes blows the whistle, Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is penalised for a foul. Brighton have a free kick.
63' Enzo Maresca has decided to substitute Noni Madueke and he is replaced by Pedro Neto (Chelsea).
63' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Chelsea.
61' The free kick is taken by Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton), but ball is cleared.
60' Dangerous play by Levi Colwill (Chelsea). Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul. Brighton get a free kick.
57' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to make a change. Igor (Brighton) replaces Adam Webster.
57' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mats Wieffer as he is replaced by Yasin Ayari (Brighton).
56' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post.
55' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
54' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
53' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
52' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
52' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
52' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Chelsea have a corner.
51' Chelsea force a corner. They send men into the box.
50' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
49' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
48' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

47' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort. It will be a corner kick for Chelsea.
46' Peter Bankes blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+9' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+7' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) is flagged for offside.
45+6' Peter Bankes couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) and blew his whistle. Chelsea will take a free kick.
45+3' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) powers a header just wide of the right post following a cross into the middle of the box.
45+2' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
45' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
41' 4 - 2 Goal! Jadon Sancho produces a great pass that finds Cole Palmer (Chelsea) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 4:2.
40' A pass from Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is intercepted by Bart Verbruggen and the move breaks down.
39' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Peter Bankes who sees an offensive foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Chelsea.
38' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the right post.
36' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
34' 3 - 2 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Carlos Baleba (Brighton), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 3:2.
33' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) for his blatant foul.
33' What a huge chance for Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
31' 3 - 1 Cole Palmer (Chelsea) scores a goal from the resulting free kick, sending it into the top right corner. What a strike that is, absolutely fantastic!
29' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) was quite harsh and Peter Bankes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
29' A yellow card for bad language! Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
28' 2 - 1 Goal! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Bart Verbruggen.
28' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
27' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
27' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul. Chelsea have been awarded a penalty kick!
25' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
25' Celebrations are cut short for Chelsea as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
24' The Chelsea players joy may have been justified, because referee Peter Bankes is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
23' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
21' 1 - 1 Goal! Great play by Nicolas Jackson releases Cole Palmer (Chelsea) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom left corner. 1:1.
19' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Cole Palmer (Chelsea) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
19' A long pass into the box is latched onto by Cole Palmer (Chelsea), who looks up and slams a terrific shot past the keeper but onto the right post. He did everything right but score!
16' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Robert Sanchez intercepts the ball.
15' The linesman signals that Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
14' Brighton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
12' A pass from Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) is intercepted by Bart Verbruggen and the move breaks down.
11' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) makes a rough challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul. Brighton have been awarded a free kick.
11' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
11' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
10' Referee Peter Bankes points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Brighton players.
10' The Brighton players halt their celebrations as referee Peter Bankes makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
9' Looks like Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
9' The game is interrupted now, Georginio Rutter (Brighton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Georginio Rutter (Brighton) is gifted a chance inside the box and makes no mistake putting the ball into the net with a fine header. 0:1.
5' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
3' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
2' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
2' A pass from Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) is intercepted by Robert Sanchez and the move breaks down.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Brighton will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Peter Bankes.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
